children: Deutsche Lufthansa reappointed Till Streichert as chief financial officer for an additional five-year term and extended the mandates of two other executive board members.
The German carrier group said Streichert, who has been a member of the executive board since 2024, could stay on as CFO through Sept. 14, 2032.

The company also said that Chief Technology Officer Grazia Vittadini had been appointed for a further three-year term through June 30, 2030, while Chief Commercial Officer Dieter Vranckx was reappointed for a further five-year term through June 30, 2032.
